text: The National Volcanic Hazard and Risk Model (NVHRM) is an integrated framework in New Zealand designed to quantify volcanic hazards and translate them into risk and loss metrics for decision-makers in government and insurance sectors. It builds on the National Volcanic Hazard Model (NVHM) and incorporates probabilistic, multi-hazard volcanic hazard modeling, coupled with advanced loss modeling capabilities led by the Earthquake Commission (EQC). The model supports applications in reinsurance, disaster risk reduction, and resilience planning, aligning with national and international disaster risk reduction agendas.
